title: Coordinated Console Launch: Rollouts, Release Notes & Training Sprints
creator: Maya Lopez
description: Run a coordinated launch for the Console UX feature set (dashboards, rollout controls, cost breakdowns) that includes: structured release notes, a staged rollout plan, internal and external training, and aligned comms for support and sales. Goal: ensure high-quality first impressions, minimize support churn, and capture product usage signals for post-launch optimizations.
acceptance_criteria: Published release notes on docs site and in-product release modal
Training materials (slides + short video) available for Support and Solutions by 2026-03-25
Canary rollout config tested internally and verified by Reliability with >=99.5% success on key flows
Console telemetry dashboard for rollout health live with alerting to #console-ops
Customer-facing messaging approved by PR/Comms and legal (for marquee customers)
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Internal Preview (2026-03-18): invite product partners + Platform Guild; collect early feedback
Phase 1 - Canary (2026-03-22): 5% of eligible tenants via feature flag, monitor latency, errors, and key dashboard queries
Phase 2 - Broad Beta (2026-03-29): 30% rollout with opt-in feedback banner and short survey
Phase 3 - GA (2026-04-01): Gradual ramp to 100% with throttled batch deployments per region; enable migration scripts for legacy dashboards
training_plan: Week 1: Create short explainer video (4-6 min) showing dashboards and rollout UI; host on internal Confluence + Loom
Week 2: Run two cross-functional workshops (Support + Solutions + Sales) + publish FAQ doc
Office hours: Schedule three 30-min Q&A sessions during the first two weeks of Beta
Enable success playbooks for Solutions Engineers with sample queries and troubleshooting steps
release_notes_draft: New: Per-route and per-model cost breakdowns in the Cost Insights panel (hover for unit-cost context).
Improved: Rollouts page now supports canary weights and version pinning for Dedicated customers.
New: Dashboard templates for latency SLOs and token-spend by API key.
Notes: No client SDK changes required. Admins will see an in-console banner at GA with opt-out instructions.
updates: 2026-03-06 - Kickoff: Aligned cross-functional owners. Ravi confirmed canary infra and suggested autoscale guardrails.
2026-03-09 - Design review: Lena provided updated microcopy for rollout modal; requested accessibility checks (contrast + focus order).
2026-03-11 - Docs sync: Liam requested final API cost mappings by 2026-03-15 for release notes accuracy.
2026-03-12 - Security: Security reviewed data surfaced in cost breakdowns; recommends masking PII and adding KMS note. Action: ENG-4210 to implement masking.
2026-03-13 - Support readiness: Priya requested two troubleshooting playbooks (dashboard load errors and missing cost rows). Assigned to Aisha for authoring.
2026-03-14 - Decision: Move GA date to 2026-04-01 to allow extended Beta for enterprise customers and time for legal signoff on customer comms.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Cost breakdown queries could add load to slow analytics. Mitigation: precompute samples and enable per-tenant caching at the gateway.
Risk: Confusion about rollout semantics across Dedicated and Hosted tiers. Mitigation: Add explicit in-product copy + short flow diagrams in release notes.
Risk: Support spike from early adopters. Mitigation: Expand on-call pool during first two Beta weeks and surface telemetry-based triage runbook.
notes: Trade-off: We will not include embedded tutorial tours in Beta to reduce engineering scope; will add for GA if Beta NPS >= 7.
Follow-up: Add a post-mortem ticket to capture learnings 2 weeks after GA (PM-6025).
Approval: Marketing requested a customer case study template; Zoe will draft by 2026-03-20.
